_note: FICTIONAL brand, illustrative only. Shape of the case file read by evidence_ledger.py, palette_logic_analyzer.py, process_reconstructor.py and method_transfer_guard.py.

artifacts.source: logo lockup on bag front, photographed
artifacts.note: Wordmark in serif, lowercase, leaf glyph replaces the u counter.
Terracotta field covers about 55 percent of the front. Cream label. Green only in the origin stamp.
Cream background, terracotta headings, generous margins, one photo per section.
Studio says the identity 'celebrates the ritual of a slow morning'.
Warm food photography on cream, no stock imagery, no faces.
Name given as a family nickname.

claims.statement: The leaf glyph inside the wordmark ties the mark to the product origin.
alternatives: The leaf is a generic nature cue chosen from a template
The studio added it for legibility at small sizes
claims.pattern: Fuse one origin cue into a letter counter instead of adding a separate symbol.

implies.requirement: The brand promise leans on origin and craft, not on price or speed.

claims.statement: One warm field colour dominates the pack, with a cool dark green used only for proof stamps.
claims.pattern: Give one warm hue more than half of the surface and reserve one cool hue for proof elements.

implies.requirement: Recognition from distance on a shelf mattered more than range of colour.

claims.statement: Photography is warm, food-led and faceless.
claims.pattern: Photograph the product in use with no faces, on the brand's ground colour.

claims.statement: The idea is a slow, unhurried start to the day.
claims.pattern: State the idea as a daily moment the product owns.

claims.statement: Margins and one-image-per-section rhythm suggest a strict spacing scale.
alternatives: The site uses a theme with these defaults

claims.statement: The brand was positioned against capsule and supermarket coffee.
The budget probably allowed one print run of packaging before launch.
